CA.rationale: Content (red at candidate) explicitly paired with a processing-origin claim (command_estimate) for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red) plus explicit organization/access metadata (origin) and status differentiation for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Origin fields (command_estimate, inherited_current) explicitly describe processing/transfer conditions tied to the same content referents.

C.rationale: Report lists explicit named contents (red/blue) as coordinate sets tied to labeled referents and times.

D.rationale: Origins and candidate/current labels separately attribute provenance/status distinct from the listed content coordinates.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates map to display orientation and includes origin/representation metadata describing presentation/access.
